description: Create the web/ frontend build pipeline and the two read-only React widgets. Install UI deps (react, react-dom, embla-carousel-react; devDeps esbuild, tailwindcss@^4, @tailwindcss/cli, @types/react, @types/react-dom). Build the explore-product Embla carousel widget and the getproductbyid single-card widget with @openai/apps-sdk-ui components, hydrating from the MCP Apps tool-result notification via @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react (useApp + useHostStyles + addEventListener('toolresult')). Produce one self-contained, minified ESM bundle per widget (React + apps-sdk-ui + Embla + inlined Tailwind CSS) at web/dist/<name>.js via web/build.mjs. This feature is INDEPENDENT of server changes except that FEAT-002 consumes its web/dist bundles, so it MUST come first.
steps: Install deps: `npm install react react-dom embla-carousel-react` and `npm install -D esbuild tailwindcss@^4 @tailwindcss/cli @types/react @types/react-dom`. (ext-apps and @openai/apps-sdk-ui are already in package.json.) Confirm with `npm ls react react-dom embla-carousel-react esbuild tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli`.

Create web/src/types.ts: duplicate the Product, Money, ProductImage, ProductVariant interfaces from src/payally-types/product.ts (do NOT import from ../src — web/ is outside tsconfig rootDir). These are plain TS interfaces used for typing structuredContent in the widgets.

Create web/src/styles.css starting with EXACTLY these three at-rules in order: `@import 'tailwindcss';` then `@import '@openai/apps-sdk-ui/css';` then `@source '../../node_modules/@openai/apps-sdk-ui';` (the @source path is relative to web/src/, i.e. two levels up to the repo root node_modules). Add any small base styles (e.g. transparent body, box-sizing) after.

Create web/src/useToolResult.tsx exporting a hook useToolResult<T>() that: calls useApp({ appInfo: { name: 'payally-widget', version: '1.0.0' }, capabilities: {} }) from '@modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps/react'; keeps state `data: T | null`; in onAppCreated registers `app.addEventListener('toolresult', (params) => setData((params.structuredContent ?? null) as T | null))` so no notification is missed; also seeds from app.getHostContext()?.toolInfo if a result is already present; calls useHostStyles(app, app?.getHostContext()); returns { data, isConnected }. Treat data as untrusted (guard fields before rendering).

Create web/src/explore-product.tsx: import './styles.css'; define the output type { query: string; products: Product[]; nextPageToken?: string }; mount with createRoot(document.getElementById('root')!). The component uses useToolResult<ExploreOutput>(); const [emblaRef, emblaApi] = useEmblaCarousel({ align: 'start', dragFree: true, containScroll: 'trimSnaps', loop: false }) from 'embla-carousel-react'; render a viewport div with ref={emblaRef} and overflow hidden, containing a flex container of product cards. Each card uses @openai/apps-sdk-ui/components/Image for image (url = product.image?.url ?? product.images?.[0]?.url), the title, seller, price formatted with Intl.NumberFormat currency, and a rating row using Star/StarFilled icons + count when product.rating is present. Add prev/next arrow buttons (Icon ChevronLeft/ChevronRight) wired to emblaApi?.scrollPrev()/scrollNext(); track canScrollPrev/canScrollNext in state updated via emblaApi.on('select', ...).on('reInit', ...) inside a useEffect, disabling buttons at the ends. Use EmptyMessage when products is empty or data is null. Drag-to-scroll is enabled by default. Read-only: NO action buttons, NO callServerTool/sendMessage, NO follow-up messages.

Create web/src/get-product-by-id.tsx: import './styles.css'; mount into #root; component uses useToolResult<Product>() and renders ONE product card — a large Image, title, seller, category as a Badge, description text, price (Intl currency), and rating (Star/StarFilled + count) when present. Purely visual; no buttons/links that trigger behavior. Show EmptyMessage/skeleton while data is null.

Create web/build.mjs (an ESM Node script run with `node web/build.mjs`): (1) Compile CSS once with @tailwindcss/cli: run its programmatic build (or spawn `npx @tailwindcss/cli -i web/src/styles.css -o web/dist/styles.css --minify`) to get the resolved Tailwind + apps-sdk-ui CSS as a string. (2) For each entry ['explore-product','get-product-by-id'] call esbuild.build with entryPoints, bundle:true, format:'esm', minify:true, jsx:'automatic', platform:'browser', target:'es2020', outfile to a temp, and define 'process.env.NODE_ENV':'"production"'. (3) Prepend a tiny self-executing snippet to each bundle that creates a

Add npm scripts to package.json: "build:ui": "node web/build.mjs" and "prestart": "npm run build:ui" (so `npm start` builds the UI before tsx reads the bundles). Optionally add /build and web/dist to .gitignore.
Run `npm run build:ui` and fix any build/type errors in the widget sources until both bundles are produced.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run build:ui` exits 0 and produces non-empty web/dist/explore-product.js and web/dist/get-product-by-id.js.
Each bundle contains the inlined Tailwind + apps-sdk-ui CSS (a <style> injection) AND the React widget code (grep the bundle for a style injection and for 'createRoot').
explore-product.tsx uses useEmblaCarousel with prev/next arrows and default drag-to-scroll, and contains NO action buttons, NO callServerTool/sendMessage, NO follow-up-message calls.
get-product-by-id.tsx renders a single product card with no interactive/behavioral controls.
Both widgets import styles.css that begins with the three required at-rules, and both hydrate from app.addEventListener('toolresult', ...) reading params.structuredContent.
package.json has build:ui and prestart scripts; required deps are installed.
verification: npm ls react react-dom embla-carousel-react esbuild tailwindcss @tailwindcss/cli  (all resolve)
Confirm web/dist/explore-product.js and web/dist/get-product-by-id.js exist and are non-empty, and each contains both a CSS <style> injection and 'createRoot'.
